serum_igg_crc_raw_areas.name: Human Serum IgG N-Glycomics Cohort (CRC vs Adenoma vs Healthy — Raw Peak Areas)
serum_igg_crc_raw_areas.description: 36 clinical serum IgG samples across 3 groups (Healthy_Control, Benign_Adenoma, Colorectal_Cancer), 33 N-glycans including Paucimannose-type N-glycans (H3N2, H3N2F1, H4N2, H4N2F1), High-Mannose (H5N2–H9N2), Hybrid-Proxy, and Complex N-glycans measured as Raw UPLC-FLR/MS Peak Areas + Clinical Metadata.

plasma_total_nglycome_diabetes.name: Human Plasma Total N-Glycome Cohort (T2D & Diabetic Nephropathy — Relative Abundance %)
plasma_total_nglycome_diabetes.description: 30 human plasma samples across 3 groups (Healthy, Type2_Diabetes, Diabetic_Nephropathy), 29 N-glycan compositions including Paucimannose-type N-glycans (H3N2, H3N2F1, H4N2), High-Mannose, Hybrid, and bi-, tri-, and tetra-antennary sialylated/fucosylated Complex N-glycans expressed as Relative Abundance (%).

gareg_formula_reference.name: GAREG Formula Validation Benchmark Dataset (CDH vs LDH — 41 Samples x 37 Glycans)
gareg_formula_reference.description: 41 samples (LDH: 22, CDH: 19) and 37 glycan compositions from the GAREG Compositional Glycan Traits Formula Reference Workbook.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: All valid classified glycan compositions in the dataset (k = 1..D).
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances (100 * p_ik) of all included glycan compositions in sample i.
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: None (absolute sum of sample relative abundance).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Sum of all included glycan relative abundances in each sample. Primarily serves as a data quality control variable (expected ~100% for closed relative abundance datasets).
trait_definitions.Limitations: Does not reflect absolute physical concentration; verifies compositional closure.

trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: 100 * sum_k(p_ik * I(N_k = 2 and 5 <= H_k <= 9 and F_k = 0 and S_k = 0))
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: HexNAc = 2 and 5 <= Hex <= 9 (with Fucose = 0 and Sialic acid = 0: H5N2, H6N2, H7N2, H8N2, H9N2).
trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Compositions with HexNAc != 2, Hex < 5, Hex > 9, or carrying fucose/sialic acid.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of glycans matching H5N2, H6N2, H7N2, H8N2, and H9N2.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total abundance of the high-mannose candidate composition pool (H5N2-H9N2).
trait_definitions.Limitations: High-mannose composition pool / candidate pool only. Does not claim definitive structural isomer classification without validated structural confirmation.

trait_definitions.Mathematical_Formula: T03_i = 100 \sum_k p_{ik} I(1 \le H_k \le 4,\ N_k = 2,\ 0 \le F_k \le 1,\ S_k = 0)
trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: 100 * sum_k(p_ik * I(1 <= H_k <= 4 and N_k = 2 and 0 <= F_k <= 1 and S_k = 0))
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: 1 <= Hex <= 4, HexNAc = 2, 0 <= Fucose <= 1, and Sialic acid = 0 (Paucimannose-type N-glycans: e.g., H2N2, H3N2, H4N2, H2N2F1, H3N2F1, H4N2F1).
trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Compositions with HexNAc != 2, Hex >= 5 (High-Mannose), Fucose >= 2, or Sialic acid >= 1.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all Paucimannose-type N-glycan compositions (Man1–4GlcNAc2Fuc0–1).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of Paucimannose-type N-glycans (truncated N-glycans with 1–4 mannose residues on the chitobiose core, with or without core fucose, such as H3N2, H3N2F1, H4N2, H4N2F1; kept distinct from classical Man5–Man9 high-mannose N-glycans).
trait_definitions.Limitations: Composition-derived paucimannose pool (1 <= H <= 4, N = 2, F <= 1, S = 0). Definitive structural isomer and core alpha1,6-fucose confirmation require structural annotation.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 3 HexNAc residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total abundance of compositions with N = 3, serving as a composition-based hybrid-compatible proxy pool.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Do not label all N3 compositions as confirmed hybrid structures; monoantennary complex or truncated bisected structures can also share N = 3.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 4 HexNAc residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total abundance of compositions with N = 4.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Monosaccharide composition class only; cannot distinguish biantennary complex glycans from monoantennary bisected or hybrid bisected isomers.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 5 HexNAc residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total abundance of compositions with N = 5.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Monosaccharide composition class only; cannot distinguish triantennary glycans from biantennary glycans with a bisecting GlcNAc.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 6 HexNAc residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total abundance of compositions with N = 6.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Monosaccharide composition class only; cannot distinguish tetraantennary glycans from triantennary bisected or polylactosamine structures.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing 4 or more HexNAc residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total abundance of compositions with N >= 4 (Complex-Candidate Composition Pool).
trait_definitions.Limitations: Composition-based classification only, not definitive structural evidence of complex-type N-glycans.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing at least one fucose residue.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of all fucosylated glycan compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Cannot distinguish core (alpha1,6) fucosylation from antennary (Lewis-type) fucosylation.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing zero fucose residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of all non-fucosylated (afucosylated) glycan compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Reflects compositional absence of fucose across all glycan classes.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 1 fucose residue.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of compositions carrying a single fucose residue.
trait_definitions.Limitations: F = 1 does not prove core fucosylation; monofucosylated glycans may carry their single fucose on either the core or an antenna.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 2 fucose residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of compositions carrying exactly two fucose residues.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Counts strictly F = 2 (distinct from multifucosylated F >= 2). Does not resolve whether one fucose is core and one is antennary vs. two antennary fucoses.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: All valid compositions with Fucose (F_k >= 1 contribute positively; F_k = 0 contribute 0).
trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Compositions with Fucose = 0 have zero weighted contribution.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of fucose residue counts across all glycans in sample i.
trait_definitions.Unit: Fucose residue equivalents per 100 relative abundance units
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted fucose residue equivalents per 100 relative abundance units.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Abundance-weighted residue equivalent, not a direct absolute molar concentration.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: glycans with F >= 1 weighted by F_k; Denominator: all valid classified glycans.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of fucose counts: sum_k(P_ik * F_k).
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total classified glycan relative abundance: sum_k(P_ik).
trait_definitions.Unit: Mean fucose residues per glycan molecule
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted average number of fucose residues per glycan across the entire sample profile.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Normalized to total classified glycan abundance; returns NA if total sample abundance is zero.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: Fucosylation Ratio Within the N≥4 Pool
trait_definitions.Mathematical_Formula: T15_i = 100 \times \frac{\sum_k p_{ik} I(N_k \ge 4,\ F_k \ge 1)}{\sum_k p_{ik} I(N_k \ge 4)}
trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: 100 * sum_k(p_ik * I(N_k >= 4 and F_k >= 1)) / sum_k(p_ik * I(N_k >= 4))
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: HexNAc >= 4 and Fucose >= 1; Denominator: HexNAc >= 4.
trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans with HexNAc < 4 are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Total relative abundance of glycans with N >= 4 and F >= 1.
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total relative abundance of all glycans with N >= 4 (T08).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of the N>=4 complex-candidate composition pool that carries at least one fucose residue.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Returns NA if the N>=4 pool denominator (T08) is zero. Does not distinguish core vs. antennary fucosylation within N>=4.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing at least one sialic acid residue.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of all sialylated glycan compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Generic S does not distinguish Neu5Ac from Neu5Gc or alpha2,3 from alpha2,6 linkage.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of glycans with at least one sialic acid residue and zero fucose residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of sialylated glycans that lack fucose.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Composition-level co-occurrence class only.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of glycans containing both sialic acid (S >= 1) and fucose (F >= 1).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of glycans simultaneously carrying sialic acid and fucose.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Does not imply a sialyl-Lewis epitope; fucose may be on the core while sialic acid is on an antenna.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: All valid compositions with Sialic acid (S_k >= 1 contribute positively; S_k = 0 contribute 0).
trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Compositions with Sialic acid = 0 have zero weighted contribution.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of sialic acid residue counts across all glycans in sample i.
trait_definitions.Unit: Sialic acid residue equivalents per 100 relative abundance units
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted sialic acid residue equivalents per 100 relative abundance units.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Abundance-weighted residue equivalent, not an absolute molar concentration.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: Mean Sialic Acid Residues per Glycan
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: glycans with S >= 1 weighted by S_k; Denominator: all valid classified glycans.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of sialic acid counts: sum_k(P_ik * S_k).
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total classified glycan relative abundance: sum_k(P_ik).
trait_definitions.Unit: Mean sialic acid residues per glycan molecule
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted average number of sialic acid residues per glycan molecule.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Normalized to total classified glycan abundance; returns NA if total sample abundance is zero.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: Sialylation Ratio Within the N≥4 Pool
trait_definitions.Mathematical_Formula: T21_i = 100 \times \frac{\sum_k p_{ik} I(N_k \ge 4,\ S_k \ge 1)}{\sum_k p_{ik} I(N_k \ge 4)}
trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: 100 * sum_k(p_ik * I(N_k >= 4 and S_k >= 1)) / sum_k(p_ik * I(N_k >= 4))
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: HexNAc >= 4 and Sialic acid >= 1; Denominator: HexNAc >= 4.
trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans with HexNAc < 4 are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Total relative abundance of glycans with N >= 4 and S >= 1.
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total relative abundance of all glycans with N >= 4 (T08).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of the N>=4 complex-candidate composition pool that carries at least one sialic acid residue.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Returns NA if the N>=4 pool denominator (T08) is zero. Does not resolve alpha2,3 vs. alpha2,6 linkage.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: all valid glycans weighted by H_k; Denominator: all valid classified glycans.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of hexose counts: sum_k(P_ik * H_k).
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total classified glycan relative abundance: sum_k(P_ik).
trait_definitions.Unit: Mean hexose residues per glycan molecule
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted average number of hexose (Hex) residues per glycan across the sample.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Reflects total Hex count; cannot distinguish mannose from galactose or glucose.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: all valid glycans weighted by N_k; Denominator: all valid classified glycans.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of HexNAc counts: sum_k(P_ik * N_k).
trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total classified glycan relative abundance: sum_k(P_ik).
trait_definitions.Unit: Mean HexNAc residues per glycan molecule
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted average number of HexNAc (N) residues per glycan across the sample.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Reflects total HexNAc count; does not distinguish core, antennary, bisecting, or GalNAc (LacdiNAc) residues.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: N≥4 Hexose Excess Above Three (Non-Specific Hexose Index)
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance-weighted sum of max(H_k - 3, 0) for all glycans with N_k >= 4.
trait_definitions.Unit: Hexose excess equivalents per 100 relative abundance units
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance-weighted excess of hexose residues above the trimannosyl core count (3) within the N>=4 composition pool.
trait_definitions.Limitations: NON-SPECIFIC HEXOSE PROXY ONLY. Must NOT be called true galactosylation because Hex composition alone cannot distinguish galactose from extra mannose or alpha-Gal.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: Mean Hexose Excess Above Three per N≥4 Glycan
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: N >= 4 weighted by max(H_k - 3, 0); Denominator: N >= 4 (T08).
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: N>=4 Hexose Excess Above Three (T24).
trait_definitions.Unit: Mean hexose excess above 3 per N≥4 glycan
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Average number of hexose residues above three per glycan within the N>=4 complex-candidate pool.
trait_definitions.Limitations: NON-SPECIFIC HEXOSE PROXY ONLY; returns NA if T08 is zero. Must not be reported as confirmed galactosylation without structural validation.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: N4 Fraction Within the N≥4 Pool
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Total abundance of N = 4 glycans (T05).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of the N>=4 composition pool accounted for by N = 4 compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Composition class fraction only, not confirmed biantennary fraction. Returns NA if T08 is zero.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: N5 Fraction Within the N≥4 Pool
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Total abundance of N = 5 glycans (T06).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of the N>=4 composition pool accounted for by N = 5 compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Composition class fraction only, not confirmed triantennary fraction. Returns NA if T08 is zero.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: N6 Fraction Within the N≥4 Pool
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Total abundance of N = 6 glycans (T07).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of the N>=4 composition pool accounted for by N = 6 compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Composition class fraction only, not confirmed tetraantennary fraction. Note: If N>=7 compositions exist, T26+T27+T28 will be less than 100%.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing 2 or more fucose residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Total relative abundance of multifucosylated glycans (F >= 2), distinct from strictly difucosylated (F = 2, T12).
trait_definitions.Limitations: Includes F = 2, F = 3, and higher fucosylation; does not resolve linkage positions.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing 7 or more HexNAc residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of extended HexNAc compositions (N >= 7). When > 0, T26 + T27 + T28 < 100%.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Cannot distinguish polylactosamine repeats from tetraantennary bisected structures.

trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: F >= 1 weighted by F_k; Denominator: S >= 1 weighted by S_k.
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Fucose Residue Equivalents (T13).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Ratio of abundance-weighted fucose residues to sialic acid residues.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Returns NA if total sialic acid residue equivalents (T19) is zero.

trait_definitions.Mathematical_Formula: T30_i = 100 \times \frac{\sum_k p_{ik} I(F_k \ge 1,\ S_k \ge 1)}{\sum_k p_{ik} I(F_k \ge 1)}
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: F >= 1 and S >= 1 (T18); Denominator: F >= 1 (T09).
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sialylated and Fucosylated Glycan Abundance (T18).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of fucosylated glycans that are also sialylated.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Returns NA if T09 is zero.

trait_definitions.Mathematical_Formula: T31_i = 100 \times \frac{\sum_k p_{ik} I(S_k \ge 1,\ F_k \ge 1)}{\sum_k p_{ik} I(S_k \ge 1)}
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: S >= 1 and F >= 1 (T18); Denominator: S >= 1 (T16).
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sialylated and Fucosylated Glycan Abundance (T18).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Percentage of sialylated glycans that also carry fucose.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Returns NA if T16 is zero.

trait_definitions.Trait_Name: High-Mannose Abundance Relative to Total Classified Abundance
trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Numerator: High-Mannose Candidate Pool (T02); Denominator: Total Glycan Abundance (T01).
trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: High-Mannose Composition Pool (T02).
trait_definitions.Interpretation: High-mannose candidate pool normalized directly to total classified sample abundance.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Candidate composition pool only; returns NA if T01 is zero.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing exactly 1 sialic acid residue.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of monosialylated glycan compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Does not distinguish sialic acid subtype or linkage.

trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of all glycans containing 2 or more sialic acid residues.
trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of di-, tri-, and polysialylated glycan compositions.
trait_definitions.Limitations: Does not distinguish sialic acid subtype or linkage.

structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with experimentally validated fucose attached to the innermost reducing-end GlcNAc via α1,6 linkage.
structural_trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans lacking validated core α1,6-fucose or having composition-only labels.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of glycans with structurally confirmed core α1,6-fucosylation.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of glycans carrying an experimentally confirmed core α1,6-fucose on the reducing-end GlcNAc.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Fucose count (e.g. F = 1) cannot distinguish core vs. antennary fucosylation.

structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with experimentally validated fucose attached to antenna GlcNAc or Gal residues.
structural_trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans without validated antennary fucose or having composition-only labels.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of glycans with structurally confirmed antennary fucosylation.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of glycans carrying an experimentally confirmed antenna-associated (e.g. Lewis-type) fucose.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Requires linkage/branch structural annotation or MS/MS diagnostic fragments.

Required_Components: Validated Structural Annotation (Bisecting β1,4-GlcNAc on β-Man)
structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with a structurally confirmed bisecting β1,4-GlcNAc attached to the central β-mannose of the N-glycan core.
structural_trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans lacking confirmed bisecting GlcNAc or having composition-only labels.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of glycans with structurally confirmed bisecting GlcNAc.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of glycans containing a structurally confirmed bisecting GlcNAc residue.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. HexNAc count (e.g. N5) cannot distinguish biantennary bisected from triantennary non-bisected structures.

structural_trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: Total galactosylated abundance (%), Mean galactose residues/glycan, Complex-pool galactosylation, and Per-antenna galactosylation
structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with structurally confirmed antennary galactose residues.
structural_trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans without structural galactose annotation or composition-only data.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance of confirmed galactosylated glycans and galactose residue counts on antennae.
structural_trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total abundance, confirmed complex-type pool abundance, or confirmed total antennae.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Experimentally established galactosylation based on confirmed antennary galactose residues.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Total Hex minus 3 (T24/T25) must never be used as a replacement for true galactosylation.

structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with experimentally confirmed hybrid N-glycan branch topology (mannose-only α1,6 arm and GlcNAc-initiated α1,3 arm).
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of structurally confirmed hybrid-type N-glycans.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of structurally confirmed hybrid-type N-glycans.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. N3 (T04) is only a composition proxy, not structural confirmation.

structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with experimentally confirmed complex-type N-glycan topology.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances of structurally confirmed complex-type N-glycans.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of structurally confirmed complex-type N-glycans.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. N>=4 (T08) is only a candidate pool, not structural confirmation.

structural_trait_definitions.Trait_Name: Confirmed Antennarity (Bi-, Tri-, Tetra-, Higher-Order Branching)
structural_trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: 100 * sum_k(p_ik * I(confirmed antenna count = a)) for Bi (2), Tri (3), Tetra (4), Higher (>=5)
structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with structurally confirmed GlcNAc-initiated antenna branching count.
structural_trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans without validated branching topology or composition-only data.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Sum of relative abundances for each confirmed antennarity category (Bi-, Tri-, Tetra-, >=5-antennary).
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance of structurally confirmed biantennary, triantennary, tetraantennary, and higher-order branched N-glycans.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. N5 cannot be classified as definitively triantennary nor N6 as definitively tetraantennary without ruling out bisecting GlcNAc and LacNAc repeats.

structural_trait_definitions.Trait_Name: Sialic Acid Linkage (α2,3 vs. α2,6 Sialylation)
structural_trait_definitions.Plain_Formula: Total alpha2,3-sialylated abundance (%), Total alpha2,6-sialylated abundance (%), and relative linkage contribution (%)
Required_Components: Validated Structural Annotation (Sialic Acid α2,3 / α2,6 Linkage)
structural_trait_definitions.Inclusion_Criteria: Glycans with linkage-specific sialic acid characterization (e.g., ethyl esterification / lactonization, sialidase digestion, or linkage-resolved MS/MS).
structural_trait_definitions.Exclusion_Criteria: Glycans with generic S or NeuAc composition lacking linkage validation.
structural_trait_definitions.Numerator_Definition: Abundance and residue equivalents of confirmed α2,3- and α2,6-linked sialylated glycans.
structural_trait_definitions.Denominator_Definition: Total abundance and total linkage-confirmed sialic acid pool.
structural_trait_definitions.Interpretation: Abundance and relative contribution of α2,3-sialylation and α2,6-sialylation.
structural_trait_definitions.Limitations: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Linkage type must never be inferred from generic S or NeuAc count alone.

not_derivable_traits.reason: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Fucose count (e.g. F = 1) cannot distinguish core vs. antennary fucosylation.
NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Requires linkage/branch structural annotation or MS/MS diagnostic fragments.
NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. HexNAc count (e.g. N5) cannot distinguish biantennary bisected from triantennary non-bisected structures.
not_derivable_traits.required_evidence: Validated Structural Annotation (Bisecting β1,4-GlcNAc on β-Man)

not_derivable_traits.reason: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Total Hex minus 3 (T24/T25) must never be used as a replacement for true galactosylation.
NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. N3 (T04) is only a composition proxy, not structural confirmation.
NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. N>=4 (T08) is only a candidate pool, not structural confirmation.

not_derivable_traits.trait_name: Confirmed Antennarity (Bi-, Tri-, Tetra-, Higher-Order Branching)
not_derivable_traits.reason: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. N5 cannot be classified as definitively triantennary nor N6 as definitively tetraantennary without ruling out bisecting GlcNAc and LacNAc repeats.

not_derivable_traits.trait_name: Sialic Acid Linkage (α2,3 vs. α2,6 Sialylation)
not_derivable_traits.reason: NOT DERIVABLE FROM COMPOSITION-ONLY DATA. Linkage type must never be inferred from generic S or NeuAc count alone.

classification_table.scientific_rationale: Any composition with F >= 1 contributes to total fucosylated abundance regardless of core vs. antennary position.
Directly counts compositions with exactly F = 1 without claiming core or antenna location.
Directly counts compositions with exactly F = 2.
Abundance-weighted sum of S_k per 100 relative abundance units.
Directly sums compositions with HexNAc (N) = 4 as a composition class.
Directly sums compositions with HexNAc (N) = 5 as a composition class.
Directly sums compositions with HexNAc (N) = 6 as a composition class.
H5N2-H9N2 compositions define the high-mannose candidate pool; structural isomer verification requires orthogonal evidence.
H1-H4N2F0-1 compositions (e.g., H2N2, H3N2, H3N2F1, H4N2, H4N2F1) define the truncated paucimannose-type N-glycan pool distinct from Man5-Man9 high-mannose glycans.
Fucose count alone cannot distinguish α1,6-core fucose on the reducing-end GlcNAc from antennary fucose.
Requires linkage and branch topology confirmation (e.g., α1,2/α1,3/α1,4 antennary attachment).
HexNAc count alone cannot distinguish β1,4-bisecting GlcNAc from an additional GlcNAc-initiated antenna.
Hexose count cannot distinguish galactose from mannose; Hex - 3 (T24/T25) is only a non-specific hexose proxy.
N3 compositions (T04) are only hybrid-compatible proxies; true hybrid classification requires confirmed branch topology.
N>=4 compositions (T08) are only complex-candidate pools; definitive classification requires structural confirmation.
N4/N5/N6 counts cannot establish antenna count without ruling out bisecting GlcNAc and polylactosamine extensions.
Generic S or NeuAc count provides no stereochemical linkage information; requires linkage-specific derivatization or digestion.
